mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM pf.quota_principal WHERE user_id=#{user} FOR UPDATE
SELECT space_id FROM pf.space_storage WHERE space_id=#{space} FOR UPDATE
SELECT state,version,image_id,policy_hash FROM pf.workspace_environment WHERE space_id=#{space} AND workspace_id=#{workspace}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_tool_job_binding(id,operation_id,space_id,task_id,workspace_id,environment_id,activation_operation_id) SELECT #{id},i.operation_id,i.space_id,i.task_id,i.workspace_id,e.environment_id,e.id FROM pf.workspace_tool_intent i JOIN pf.tool_operation o ON o.id=i.operation_id AND o.status='RUNNING' JOIN pf.workspace_environment_operation e ON e.id=#{activation} AND e.space_id=i.space_id AND e.workspace_id=i.workspace_id AND e.actor_id=i.actor_id WHERE i.operation_id=#{operation} AND i.tool_name='workspace_shell' ON CONFLICT(activation_operation_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_tool_job_binding WHERE operation_id=#{operation} AND activation_operation_id=#{activation})
SELECT file_id,version_id,relative_path path,coalesce(actual_bytes,0) bytes,content_sha256 sha256,status FROM pf.tool_output_capture WHERE operation_id=#{operation} ORDER BY ordinal
